singles.method: optional acoustic onset, shuttle gap and moving wrist v1
limitations: Development examples; not a held-out accuracy benchmark.
Audio onsets can be crowd, shoe, or other-court noise.
AV offset is not calibrated; intervals are review bounds, not exact hits.
Unreviewed/unknown-scene footage is excluded from strict metrics.

candidates.reason: possible contact during shuttle occlusion; review entire interval

prediction_timing.strict_metrics: Representative source times within tolerance; uncertain proposal times are navigation locations, not measured hit times
prediction_timing.uncertain_candidate_time_s: Navigation frame only; review the entire possible-contact interval

evaluation.matching: maximum cardinality, then minimum total absolute source-time error

interval_coverage.meaning: A proposal interval contains a reviewed point contact; this does not measure exact hit timing accuracy
interval_coverage.matching: one-to-one maximum-cardinality inclusive-frame containment within reviewed ranges
